about_the_game:
Stock up on all the ores you need with the Summerwind Saga - Abandoned Mines pack! ELV Games continues their Summerwind Saga series with another staple of cozy farming sims: mines full of resources! A5 and 5 B sheets offer up dirt floors and brown stone walls to create mazes of underground tunnels for your hero to explore. Use diagonal walls to give your caves more natural shapes and diagonal stone staircases to make it more interesting for your players to wander while looking for ores.

Pick up the Summerwind Saga - Abandoned Mines pack to make sure your players have access to all the ores they need to level up their tools!


Contents:

- Water tiles, ground tiles, water and underwater tiles
- Wood boxes, mineral stones, crystals for puzzles, railroads with mine carts
- Walls with minerals, signs and lamps, chairs, desks, underwater objects
- Lots of props to create Mines and Dungeons!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
